links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-generated patient education materials versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: AI-generated content reached a 10.6-grade level versus ACOG 9th and UpToDate 8.6 (P=.008); no LLM reached sixth-grade benchmark even when prompted; ChatGPT increased reading difficulty.
links.quote: Even when explicitly prompted, no large language model achieved the sixth-grade reading level required for optimal patient comprehension.

links.outcome: Plain-language readability of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: LLM materials were shorter (407.9 vs 1132.0 words) but had more difficult words (36.7% vs 27.4%; P<.001); none reached sixth-grade level.
links.quote: Large language models generated more concise patient education materials but often introduced more complex vocabulary, ultimately failing to meet recommended health literacy standards.
